comments:
Commentary on the Bodhisattvasaṃvaraviṃśaka (ID:3759), with some references to the views of other scholars, who are identified in interlinear annotations in (ID:4560). These including rNgog Blo ldan shes rab (ID:3786) ex013062025-11-2709-58-17 , Phya pa (ID:3831) ex013062025-11-2709-31-56 , "byang chub bzang po" (possibly Ar Byang chub ye shes (ID:3816)) ex013062025-11-2709-14-07 , and possibly Nyang bran Chos kyi ye shes (ID:3876) ex013062025-11-2709-31-46 .
For a scholar referred to as "dam pa kha 1" in the text, an annotation glosses "khag sor ba" ex013062025-11-2709-31-59, and for an unidentified "kha 1" an annotation glosses "rgya mtsho 'phrind" ex013062025-11-2709-07-34 .
